Welcome to Restoration Massage Center. I’m Tim Turnbow, a licensed massage therapist since 2008, Texas Licensed Massage Instructor, and continuing education provider.

This channel helps massage therapists improve their clinical reasoning, treatment techniques, body mechanics, and understanding of common pain and compensation patterns.

You’ll learn practical massage therapy techniques for:

• Shoulder impingement, rotator-cuff issues and neck pain
• Sciatica, lower-back pain and hip compensation
• Prenatal massage and safe client positioning
• TMJ, headaches and upper-body tension
• Trigger point therapy, deep-tissue techniques and cupping
• Corrective exercise, mobility and therapist body mechanics

Massage Therapists check out my online CEUS below

🎓 Online massage therapy CEU courses:
https://restorationmassagecenter.thinkific.com

Subscribe for clinical massage demonstrations, anatomy education, treatment planning and corrective-exercise strategies.
